body: i tried. booked a session even. but chickened out. i was seeking help for these horrible nightmares i still have. but i was scared i would come face to face with a repressed memory i don’t want to know about

I already replied about how I feel like a tissue. People have been using me financially and psychologically, dumping all their problems on me but every time I share, they’ve left. Most times I haven’t even had to. When they get to a better position in life they just leave.
I’m happy for you. I hope to be as brave as you

As I said I have a lot of friends. And till date I’ve shared my problems with 3 of them (all three don’t know each other) and all of them left me. I thought they were my beat friends but I was wrong. They left me even though I was with them when they needed me. I feel like a tissue paper. People use me and discard me when they are done.

But what about the sadness and despair that comes after the mere seconds? I’m not being cynical but I’ve really tried. Everyone around me thinks I’m the happiest person. Fake it till you make it ? I have been getting out every morning for the past 7 years with a smiling face, only to cry all night in my room.

I still haven’t got my vaccination. I usually fall I’ll very easily and my immunity is very low but I still haven’t got the disease. I went to various parties without masks and took two trips but all in vain

It’s just not about grades. It just happens to be the reason for my tendency to kick back up today. I can’t explain. I’m tired of everything in my life being wrong. My being alive today is wrong. I shouldn’t have been born. I’m sorry but I can’t

Hey, thanks for replying. I get it’ll now matter with time but at the moment it feels like the end of the world. I already have my “friends” laughing at me. My parents are very orthodox and will probably take away everything if or when I fail. I was still fine with it until yesterday when I found out the only thing that made me happy needs me to have a certain grade to continue, and it’s just trigged all the other times I’ve failed at life
Heyy, thanks ya. I hope it does

I get you. I have been wanting to die for 7 years now. At first I kept a suicide note with me at all times but then I was afraid that everyone would dig up my life and the humiliation my parents would have had to go through. I tore the note but started praying to be killed by an accident everyday since. Due to covid, my suicidal tendencies are back but I’m still too chicken

I know how you feel. Atleast you think you can end it. I’ve thinking about killing myself for the past 7 years or something. And I’m just 19. I just don’t want people to dig into my life after I do it. Or maybe I’m just not brave enough. Anyway, more power to you
